appraise.en: Young people are also worried about how people will appraise them, which means judge them.
appraise.zh: 年轻人还担心别人会如何评估（appraise）他们，也就是评判他们。

appraise.en: And if you appraise someone, you judge them.
appraise.zh: 如果你去“appraise”某人，意思就是你对他们做出评估或评判。

approve.en: In 2016, the UK approved a nuclear power station called Hinkley Point C, in the south-west of England.
approve.zh: 2016年，英国批准了位于英格兰西南部的欣克利角C核电站。

approve.en: But in October of last year, October 2025, Italy's government approved a new bill to bring nuclear power back: small modular reactors , new-generation designs, and even fusion.
approve.zh: 但在去年10月，即2025年10月，意大利政府批准了一项重新引入核电的新法案：小型模块化反应堆、新一代设计，甚至还包括核聚变。

appreciation.en: He returned from France with an appreciation for French food and French culture.
appreciation.zh: 他从法国归来，对法国食物和法国文化有了欣赏。

apply.en: Britain became the pioneer of mass production, and this was applied to food as well.
apply.zh: 英国成为了大规模生产的先驱，这也应用到了食物上。
